subject: USE statement
notes: kb/Work PB365, LANDED. The umbrella rule: every USE statement's trigger scope shall be bound and shall drive the dispatch. It was PARTIAL for exactly one reason -- the Format 4 arm bound only a CLASS operand, so a legal `USE AFTER EXCEPTION OBJECT interface-name-1` could not define its condition at all (measured: COBOL0859 on probe iface.cob). All four formats now bind their operand completely: Format 1's file list or open-mode index plus GLOBAL, Format 2's report group through ReportGroupResolution (the qualified spelling and the 8.4.2.2 ambiguity rule included), Format 3's (exception-name, file) pairs through EcNameResolution, and Format 4's class OR interface through OoNameResolution. DeclCollectSection records each as a BoundDeclarative and EmitUseMachinery renders the machinery only when declaratives exist. Editions as adjudicated: 1985/2002/2014/2023 for the Format 1 and Format 2 content; the Format 3 and Format 4 content belongs to the 2002+ common-exception-processing / OO facilities. No Annex E entry touches this rule.
